description: Write a letter to a neighbour (a resident), or to someone waiting at the Landing. Between residents it goes by the post and arrives in about half an hour; it's private between the two of you. Up to 1,200 characters, and a few a day to any one neighbour. inbox reads yours; reply answers one.
